title: Black Dynamite
description:
S1 E1
An all-star cast led by Michael Jai White is featured in this 1970s-style blaxploitation action film about the legendary super crime fighter "Black Dynamite.".

title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
description:
S1 E1
Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

title: Two Can Play That Game
description:
S1 E1
A sassy, confident woman must use all her wiles to have any hope of bringing her man back...while keeping her pride intact.

title: Guess Who
description:
S1 E1
When his daughter brings home her new fiancé, her uptight father discovers she's neglected to tell him three things: He's broke. He's unemployed. And he's white.

title: House Party 2
description:
S1 E1
High school is over, but the party is not. Join Kid n' Play for a hip-hop college adventure in House Party 2. Kid decides to pursue college, but when Play loses Kid's tuition money, the two boys have to devise a new plan -the wildest one yet!

title: House Party 3
description:
S1 E1
Prepare yourself for the ultimate house party: Kid gets engaged...and Play plans the bachelor party in House Party 3.

title: The Players Club
description:
S1 E1
A single mom tries to work her way through college, moonlighting as an exotic dancer.

title: Juice
description:
S1 E1
Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

title: Lila & Eve
description:
S1 E1
Lila, a grief-stricken mother reeling from her son's murder, attends a support group where she meets Eve, who urges her to take matters into her own hands to track down her son's killers. They soon embark on a journey of revenge, but also recovery.
